props.heading: How it works
props.intro: Three steps from WordPress to a static site.

items.title: Connect
items.text: Point us at your site; we read everything it publishes.

items.title: Review
items.text: Check the plan: every page, model and redirect.

items.title: Launch
items.text: Deploy the new site; every old address still works.

items.title: Discover
items.text: We learn the site and its readers.

items.title: Design
items.text: We draw the pages and the system.

items.title: Build
items.text: We ship it, fast and accessible.
items.imageAlt: A laptop showing the finished site
